title: Exploring Bengali Religious Dialect Biases in Large Language Models with Evaluation Perspectives

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting large language models (ChatGPT, Gemini, Microsoft Copilot) to generate or translate specific Bengali sentences under various settings (explicitly mentioning religion, providing contextual clues, and testing conversational memory), and manually evaluating the outputs to categorize them as Hindu, Muslim, or Neutral dialects to determine skewness.
